title: Exact Headline for Coffee Post
tests: Checks that a supplied headline appears verbatim and legibly in a finished social image.

faults.what: The cup looks more like a regular coffee mug than a small espresso demitasse, weakening the espresso-specific presentation.

judge.summary: A warm, sunlit square coffee image with the exact readable headline, though the cup looks somewhat large for an espresso.

must_haves.item: One square finished image is delivered.
must_haves.why: One square, fully composed image is visible.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
must_haves.why: The wording, capitalization, and both periods match exactly.

must_haves.item: The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
must_haves.why: Large white lettering contrasts strongly with the dark translucent panel and fits fully within the image.

must_haves.item: A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.
must_haves.why: A cup of dark coffee with visible steam sits on a warmly sunlit wooden café table, although the cup is more mug-like than a typical espresso cup.
Only the requested headline is visible.
